notes: Sources: the R&P (2018_01, May 2017 updated December 2017) is the faculty handbook; it holds the tenure-clock policies (2.2.5.7.1-2.2.5.8, also saved as 2018_03), the three types of faculty leave (2.4: academic, unpaid incl. personal reasons, medical) and the benefits list (2.7.1). 2018_02 is the R&P amendment list. 2018_00, 2018_04, 2018_05, 2018_08 are provost web pages (Faculty Dual Career Assistance Program) summarising the FML Policy for Faculty and the tenure-clock rules; 2018_06 is the provost's FMLA accommodation form; 2018_07 is the HR time-away page; 2018_09 is a 2010 FAQ on the tenure-flexibility policies.

No-policy check (`missing`): a governing document for faculty leave covering tenure-stream faculty is saved (the R&P faculty handbook, with its leave-of-absence section and tenure-clock policy), so missing is false. The governing document for the paid parental leave itself, the Family and Medical Leave Policy for Faculty (HR Policy #129 - Faculty), is cited by every summary page but not saved. Its provisions (c1, c2, c3, c8, c9) are coded from the provost and HR summaries as stated and flagged cross_reference_not_saved (the rule for a governing document cited but not saved), so they are counted.

Documents cited but not saved: Family and Medical Leave Policy for Faculty (HR Policy #129 - Faculty; 'FMLA Policy', 'FMLA Faculty Policy'); Family and Medical Leave Policy for Staff Members; HR FML Request Form; Lehigh University Employee Guide (plan descriptions, R&P 2.7.1); Short Term Disability Plan / HR Policy page; Adoption Leave for Staff Policy; Leave of Absence Policy; Sick Leave/Excused Absence: Exempt Staff Policy and Nonexempt Staff Policy; Vacation Policy; Funeral Leave, Jury Duty, Military Leave and Holidays policies; Manual for Disability Accommodation for Faculty; Tenure-clock 'Implementation Information (PDF)'; Research Grants (Lehigh Sloan) page; University Student Conduct System (updated document).

Not components: the Provost's $5,000 to the department per FML leave for adjunct replacement (pays the department); Lehigh Sloan research grants for pre-tenure faculty who take FML for parenthood (a research grant, not time, pay or relief); academic (sabbatical) leave (R&P 2.4(a), for professional development); funeral, jury, military leave and holidays (cannot be used for a birth); the child care center; disability accommodation for faculty (any disability, Yale); graduate and undergraduate student leaves of absence; R&P 2.2.12 part-time appointments for retiring faculty.

Calendar: the accommodation form defines an academic semester including the final exam period as 15 weeks; the personal-illness page refers to 'the two 15-week periods of the Fall and Spring semesters'; R&P 3.1.1 gives fourteen weeks of instruction, two RCS days and a nine-day exam period.

Parenthood FML structure: full-time FML (c1, 12 weeks at full pay) normally coincides with a semester, the remaining three weeks in non-teaching duties (c2, coded as the semester containing the leave, R3b); or intermittent FML (c3), release from teaching and service for one semester at full pay with research and supervision continuing. The two options are linked in_lieu_of (R15b). The FML's 12 weeks in any 12-month period are shared by its parenthood, own-health (c8) and family-care (c9) uses (leave_limits). FMLA (c7) runs alongside (S1).

Birth parent chain: [full-time option] FML parenthood leave 12 weeks (c1) within the semester of relief (c2, 15 weeks), FMLA 12 workweeks concurrent with c1; or [intermittent option] one semester of teaching and service relief at full pay (c3). Own-health FML (c8) with STD (c10) concurrent, within the shared 12-week FML limit. Tenure clock +1 year (c4).

Non-birth parent chain (primary caregiver): [full-time option] FML parenthood leave 12 weeks (c1) within the semester of relief (c2), FMLA concurrent with c1; or [intermittent option] c3, one semester. Family-care FML (c9) for care of the birth parent, within the shared 12-week FML limit. Tenure clock +1 year (c4).

Who is covered: c1-c3 require the non-birth parent to be the primary caregiver (R6: ignored in the roles). FML eligibility (service) is not stated in the saved sources; FMLA's 12 months and 1,250 hours applies to c7.

Tenure clock: the provost pages restate R&P 2.2.5.7; the personal-illness page says 'up to one year' where the R&P says one semester or one year (R&P governs). The FAQ's 'only one elective extension' appears only in the FAQ (U9 note on c6).
